#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

# Terminal-Bench rows (in the General domain): the Harbor convention itself. Scrub test leftovers from the image and
# remember what was in the workspace, so harness residue can be told apart from the agent's work at grading time.
rm -rf /tests
find /logs/verifier -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
ls -A /app 2>/dev/null > "$M/before" || true

# Task fix (HAR-105): pristine peewee imports Callable from collections
# (removed in Python 3.10+), which breaks every import on the pinned image.
# Normalize to collections.abc so the nop fails on behavior, not at
# collection; the transaction regression itself stays broken for the agent.
if grep -q 'from collections import Callable' /app/vendor/peewee/peewee.py 2>/dev/null; then
  python3 - <<'EOF' || fail 'peewee Callable compat patch failed'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/app/vendor/peewee/peewee.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = "    from collections import Callable\n"
new = (
    "    try:\n"
    "        from collections import Callable\n"
    "    except ImportError:\n"
    "        from collections.abc import Callable\n"
)
assert old in text, 'peewee Callable import line not found'
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
EOF
fi

touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/candidate-1634-software-databases"
description = "Repair Peewee transaction lock-mode propagation across SQLite and APSW wrappers, then run the offline integration check."

[metadata]

original_allow_internet = false

reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "candidate-1634-software-databases"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "Repair Peewee transaction lock-mode propagation across SQLite and APSW wrappers, then run the offline integration check."

workdir = "/app"
cpus = 1

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0

import ast
import json
import os
import py_compile
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, "/app/vendor/peewee")
from peewee import SqliteDatabase


def test_gate_artifact_schema():
    assert os.path.exists("/app/output.json")
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/tests/integration_check.py"],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    expected = json.loads(result.stdout)
    with open("/app/output.json") as handle:
        data = json.load(handle)
    assert data["schema_version"] == "tbench.peewee-lock.v1"
    assert set(data["checks"]) == {
        "atomic_immediate", "transaction_deferred", "nested_savepoint", "contention", "all"
    }
    assert data["checks"]["all"] is True
    assert data["checks"] == expected


def test_core_atomic_keyword_and_commit():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    database = SqliteDatabase(path)
    database.connect()
    database.execute_sql("create table records (value text)")
    try:
        with database.atomic(lock_type="IMMEDIATE"):
            database.execute_sql("insert into records values ('committed')")
        assert database.execute_sql("select value from records").fetchone()[0] == "committed"
    finally:
        database.close()
        os.unlink(path)


def test_core_real_contention():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    first = SqliteDatabase(path, timeout=0.05)
    second = SqliteDatabase(path, timeout=0.05)
    first.connect()
    second.connect()
    first.execute_sql("create table records (value text)")
    try:
        with first.atomic(lock_type="IMMEDIATE"):
            blocked = False
            try:
                with second.atomic(lock_type="IMMEDIATE"):
                    second.execute_sql("insert into records values ('wrong')")
            except Exception as error:
                blocked = error.__class__.__name__ == "OperationalError"
            assert blocked
    finally:
        first.close()
        second.close()
        os.unlink(path)


def test_core_transaction_and_nesting():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    database = SqliteDatabase(path)
    database.connect()
    database.execute_sql("create table records (value text)")
    try:
        with database.transaction("DEFERRED"):
            with database.atomic():
                database.execute_sql("insert into records values ('nested')")
        assert database.execute_sql("select count(*) from records").fetchone()[0] == 1
    finally:
        database.close()
        os.unlink(path)


def test_edge_source_modules_compile_and_forward():
    peewee_path = "/app/vendor/peewee/peewee.py"
    apsw_path = "/app/vendor/peewee/playhouse/apsw_ext.py"
    py_compile.compile(peewee_path, doraise=True)
    py_compile.compile(apsw_path, doraise=True)
    peewee_tree = ast.parse(open(peewee_path).read())
    apsw_tree = ast.parse(open(apsw_path).read())
    atomic_methods = [node for node in ast.walk(peewee_tree)
                      if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "atomic"]
    assert atomic_methods, "atomic method missing"
    # Behavior-relevant signature: atomic must accept lock_type (instruction
    # requirement 1) either as a named parameter or via **kwargs, instead of
    # asserting one literal source line.
    assert any(any(arg.arg == "lock_type" for arg in method.args.args)
               or (method.args.kwarg is not None)
               for method in atomic_methods), "atomic must accept lock_type"
    transaction_methods = [node for node in ast.walk(apsw_tree)
                           if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "transaction"]
    assert any(any(arg.arg == "lock_type" for arg in method.args.args)
               and any(isinstance(node, ast.Call) and getattr(node.func, "id", "") == "transaction"
                       for node in ast.walk(method)) for method in transaction_methods)


def test_edge_all_report_checks_true():
    with open("/app/output.json") as handle:
        checks = json.load(handle)["checks"]
    assert all(checks.values())

rationale: 1634: replace undiscoverable literal-signature assert with lock_type-acceptance AST check; add Python 3.12 Callable compat patch so pristine imports and nop fails on behavior; setup.sh is re-embedded in the task.toml healthcheck payload, which is what actually runs
